messages:
zoe: Quick note — saw p50 > p95 for a single 1m bucket on /v1/completions. Screenshot attached. Not a UI bug, right? :eyes:

matt: Usually means different sources: detail uses ingress histograms, overview uses post-routing tdigest merge. Merge lag can create timing mismatches.

anya: Also check trim policy. We sanitize extreme samples in merge job; heatmaps show raw. If heatmap includes an 8s synthetic spike but merge trimmed it, percentiles differ.

zoe: Root cause looks like both: ingress-only tail + merge trimmed a couple of samples. UX problem — we need to make origin explicit.

matt: Proposal: add a small source badge on every quantile tile: "Source: post-routing (default)". Hover explains merge latency and SLO authority. Add toggle `source=ingress|post_routing|raw` in metrics API.

anya: Backend will return `counts_by_origin` and `trimmed_count` in the metrics payload so the UI can show a tiny breakdown. Also include `sample_count` to show small-N warnings.

zoe: UX: dashed orange line for ingress, solid blue for canonical. If sample_count < 50 show "small N: quantiles approximate". Also add an "explain SQL" modal for power users.

metrics-bot: PRs created: infra/metrics-proxy#9721 (source param + counts_by_origin + trimmed_count), console/ui#4177 (badge + selector + legend).

matt: Technical caveat: include `source` in cache key; otherwise cached merged rows can leak into ingress queries. Also add a monotonicity check in metrics lib: for same-source queries assert p50<=p95<=p99; log diagnostic if violated.

anya: Tests: unit monotonicity asserts, e2e that injects a short ingress-only tail and verifies toggle and breakdown show expected inversion and counts.

zoe: Runbook blurb: "If overview vs detail disagree: check tile Source badge and counts_by_origin. If ingress >10% expect earlier anomalies; if trimmed_count>0 check if synthetic tests caused it."

ui-bot: Frontend copy suggestion: "Source: post-routing (default). Post-routing = merged, tdigest-aggregated signal used for SLOs; may lag by ~30-60s. Toggle to 'ingress' for earlier, noisier signal."

zoe: Thanks team. Let's land this and monitor for dashboard-mistrust tickets. :coffee:
